steps: Open the admin panel and click 'Export users'
cases.expected: The CSV contains exactly the set of active user accounts, one row per user, with a status column reading 'active'

cases.scenario: Soft-deleted users are excluded from export
steps: Seed the database with two active users and one soft-deleted user
cases.expected: The CSV contains the two active users only; the soft-deleted user is not present in any row

cases.scenario: Non-admin is forbidden from triggering export
steps: Log in as a regular user (non-admin role)
Send a POST to the admin export endpoint
cases.expected: Response is HTTP 403 Forbidden; no CSV is generated and the attempt is logged for audit
